active_continuity: Jeok Cheongang publicly declared himself the eighteenth Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, accepted Jin Taekyung as his Disciple, and declared that Taekyung would inherit the clan's orthodox lineage; he now agrees to oversee Taekyung's training while privately denying that they are truly master and Disciple.
Jeok's declaration ended Taekyung's opportunity to enter Heaven's Gate Temple or become another master's Disciple.
Taekyung addresses Jeok as Master, and as Old Master when they are alone.
Jeok believes Taekyung possesses the Heavenly Martial Physique, while Taekyung conceals the System.
The Unnamed Sword's true name is Fire Heaven Sword, the beloved sword of the Fire Gate Clan's tenth Sect Leader and a weapon forged from Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.
Only someone who inherits the Fire Gate Clan's legacy can draw out Fire Heaven Sword's true power; whether Taekyung can do so remains unknown.
Three Dark Heaven remnants survived interrogation under powerful restrictions and are being kept alive as the Jin Family's physical evidence.
Jin Wikyung suspects Dark Heaven's attack on Shanxi Province was only the beginning and considers the Jin Family's victory suspiciously easy.
Lee Seowol and the Mount Heng Sword Sect swore loyalty to the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and the Jin Family accepted the sect as its vassal.
Taekyung is a Level 73 Peak Master with seventy allocated stat points and completed the duel Quest and Jin Family tournament event.
Taekyung has only three months of martial-arts training, having advanced from Third Rate to the beginning of the Peak realm during that period.
Jang Taebo agreed to forge Taekyung's Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into a spear, but the work is not complete.
The Treasured Jade remains missing, and Woo Hwangtae's conflict with Chulwoo and the Jin Family remains unresolved.

Jeok severely beat Taekyung over the partly burned Flame Divine Palm manual, then performed abbreviated cleansing treatment that increased Taekyung's Muscles and Bones and Sinews and Meridians by 5 each and Strength, Stamina, and Agility by 1 each.
Ak Bulgun of the Shandong Yue Family is a spear Instructor at Heaven's Gate Temple and personally taught Jin Mukyung there.
Jeok and Taekyung publicly presented themselves as an affectionate master and Disciple at the banquet despite Taekyung's private distress.
The current gathering secured loyalty from smaller and mid-sized sects, while imperial authorities and the Shanxi merchant world began actively cooperating with the Jin Family.
Seok Family Manor proposed cooperation with the Jin Family in Shanxi's merchant world, and Jin Wikyung accepted the proposal in principle pending detailed review.
Jeok has begun personally training and evaluating Taekyung at a nearby mountain through the One Step Back Quest.
The One Step Back Quest remains incomplete after Taekyung's opening assault failed to move Jeok.
open_questions: What is Dark Heaven ultimately seeking, why was Shanxi Province targeted, and what can be learned from the three surviving remnants?
When will Jang Taebo complete Taekyung's commissioned weapon?
Who has the Treasured Jade, or was it lost by Jopil?
What consequences will follow Woo Hwangtae's conflict with Chulwoo and the Jin Family?
Will Song Il honor his pledge after returning to Zhongnan, and what consequences will follow his confrontation with the Jin Family?
Can Taekyung inherit the Fire Gate Clan's legacy and draw out Fire Heaven Sword's true power?
What level of progress will Taekyung achieve before Jeok Cheongang leaves?
Can Taekyung make Jeok retreat one step and complete the One Step Back Quest?
